shared_elements: low-relief carving of a creature on a large stone surface
animal/creature body with limbs and curved appendages
projecting or emphasized rounded head element
justification: Both surfaces bear a single low-relief zoomorphic figure rendered in a schematic, outline-and-modelled manner with curving limbs, and both show an emphasized rounded head at one end of the body, which is the most specific correspondence. But A's figure appears as a downward-oriented creature with a strongly three-dimensional protruding head and ribbed/incised body on a vertical pillar face, while B's is a flat, sprawling curvilinear creature seen frontally on a horizontal slab, with no shared attributes, companions or compositional scheme.
